scope: Conditional on the existing fitted models, query pools, splits and measured benchmark families. No retraining or population-of-families uncertainty.
ood: Paired queries resampled within each held-out family; original query weights and families retained.
iid: Paired bootstrap of unique test-query identities; all repeated split appearances and all penalties stay together. Inverse split-size weighting and normalized weighted ratios follow the existing IID diagnostic.
existing_disagreement: Preserve the existing 1000-replicate seed42 bootstrap and its published intervals; add missing disagreement and conditional-gain intervals using those exact draws.
clustering: Regenerate missing k-means assignments with the frozen ordinary KMeans settings only; audit NMI/ARI against the original before resampling held-out assignments. Do not refit inside bootstrap.
family_rank: Resample held-out queries within each family and recompute both source-error winners and retrieval ranks together; retain original equal-family/equal-penalty summary.
